answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every new identity to embed a scarce kernel credential: a hash-locked bond sized to a rolling jade index of median epoch earnings. The bond cannot be transferred, and unbonding spans several epochs. Voting weight then tracks the delta between attested work and capital at risk; a farm of cheap clones cannot outvote established workers without locking matching funds that are slashed if their grades systematically diverge from the honest majority.
